info.title: WhiteBooks GST returns: GSTR3B
info.description: Operations of the WhiteBooks GST returns API in the group GSTR3B, as of 2026-10-13. Start on the sandbox; every call needs your own WhiteBooks credentials and a session as the sign-in sequence describes.

get.summary: Get GSTR1 auto calculated liability details

parameters.name: state_cd
parameters.description: 2-digit state code (first 2 characters of the GSTIN)

parameters.name: txn
parameters.description: GST session transaction id from otprequest

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: WhiteBooks app credential from the developer portal

parameters.name: client_secret
parameters.description: WhiteBooks app credential from the developer portal

200.description: The reply. A failure can still come back as HTTP 200: check the error shapes in the WhiteBooks error reference.

default.description: A failure; the body carries the error code and message.
